description: You are the farm manager at GAEC JOULIN, a mixed crop-and-livestock farm in Charente-Maritime, France. Log in to Ekylibre at http://demo.ekylibre.farm:3000 using admin@ekylibre.org / 12345678. The farm must submit its EU CAP (Common Agricultural Policy) subsidy compliance documentation for the 2024 growing season. Prepare a crop rotation plan: create at least 3 new activity productions for a 2024 campaign, each assigned to a distinct land parcel. The plan must demonstrate genuine crop rotation — at least 2 different crop activity types must be used across the 3 parcels, applying rotation principles (e.g. alternating cereal families with oléagineux or protéagineux). All new productions must have valid growing season dates for 2024.
